title: Polymer-forming reactions
summary: Reactions joining small molecules into chains supplied the synthesis route for manufactured polymers.

parents.reason: Distillation isolated styrene in the 1839 work that observed its conversion into a solid polymer.

title: Cellulose nitration
summary: Nitrating cotton cellulose produced material used in later plastics, coatings, and propellants.

parents.reason: Separated cotton lint supplied cellulose-rich fiber feedstock for the 1846 nitration route.

title: Hydraulic cylinder actuator
summary: Pressurized liquid acting on a sealed piston supplied controllable linear force.

parents.reason: Piston pumps supplied pressurized liquid to move a load-bearing actuator piston.

title: Iron-core electromagnet
summary: Current flowing through a coil magnetized an iron core for controllable magnetic force.

parents.reason: The magnetic effect of electric current supplied the operating principle of the energized coil.
Drawn conductive wire supplied repeated turns around the magnetic core.

title: Engineered pressure vessel
summary: Strong sealed chambers contained liquids or gases at pressure different from their surroundings.

parents.reason: Metal forming produced strong vessel walls and pressure-bearing fittings.

title: Steam-generating boiler
summary: Heated sealed vessels supplied steam for practical pumping and later power machinery.

parents.reason: Pressure-bearing vessel construction contained the heated water and generated steam.

title: Cryogenic gas liquefaction
summary: Compression and strong cooling converted permanent gases into compact liquids.

parents.reason: Gas compressors supplied the pressure needed before expansion and deep cooling.
Expansion-cooling measurements informed throttling and regenerative gas-liquefaction cycles.

title: Powered air-moving fan
summary: Mechanically driven impellers moved air for mine ventilation and later industrial systems.

parents.reason: Shaped blades, shafts, and housings supplied the working structures of early ventilation fans.

title: Capacitor charge storage
summary: Separated conductive surfaces stored electrical charge across an insulating layer.

parents.reason: Glass jars supplied the insulating dielectric between the conductive layers of early Leyden capacitors.
